description:
Hushfeed v0.33.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

The three controls Hushfeed draws over the video no longer sit on TikTok's own avatar, like and share column, and hiding a rail button hides its count too. Coming back to TikTok with the return stop on shows a "Tap to start the feed" label that TalkBack announces once, and the stop leaves on its own if you open Profile or Inbox instead. A change that needs a restart pins a row to the top of every settings page that restarts TikTok when tapped, and a switch flipped back owes nothing. Hide suggested accounts covers every People you may like card, Clear all in the inbox counts as it goes and stops on a second tap, a boolean gate in the Feature Gate Lab turns on with one tap, and a structured override that can't be applied says why. The diagnostic report names what Ghost mode answered and what the CAPTCHA gate saw, and keeps it after you clear the diagnostics.

Validation: 1331 runtime tests passed locally, plus 199 in the patches module. The bundle carries 79 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. Both Android API checks passed. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
